summary: Regression test after HydroMind-X frontend refactor (extracted MessageList/ChatInput components, useVoiceChat hook, memoized ScenarioContext, table-driven decide()). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed including SSE chat streaming, chat history, audit report create+list, forecast advisory, and chatbot grounding (founder + team roster + researcher). Frontend: All flows verified end-to-end via Playwright — Dashboard sliders + weather buttons instantly recompute WAI (drought scenario dropped WAI from 74 to 1, cooling switched to Emergency Cooling); ForecastCard shows tomorrow WAI and risk badge and HYDRA advisory streams back (274 chars); Water Audit Report generates HMX- report with sensor values; Cooling page renders active strategy label; Assistant page shows greeting, voice controls, chat streaming returns founder = Anbumathi Chezhian (grounded), and suggestion chip flow works. Refactor is behavior-preserving.
critical_code_review_comments: ForecastCard.js line 13: two statements on one line (useMemo(...) followed immediately by const [advisory,...]) — works but hurts readability; recommend splitting into two lines.

Assistant.js send() has eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps because 'speak' is defined after 'send' in the same component. Current works (speak is stable useCallback in hook) but a cleaner pattern would move send below the useVoiceChat call or wrap speak in a ref. Non-blocking.

useVoiceChat.js useEffect on line 12 that updates ref callbacks has no dependency array — runs on every render. Intentional (to keep refs fresh) but consider documenting or using a layout effect. Non-blocking.
